products.name: Sociedad Opita
products.tagline_es: La app que une a los opitas con su tierra
products.tagline_en: The app that connects the opitas with their land
products.description_es: Donde la abuela Doña Rosa, el Padre Cecilio y los personajes del Huila se vuelven parte de tu familia digital. Un juego serio sobre memoria, tradición y orgullo regional.
products.description_en: Where Grandma Doña Rosa, Father Cecilio and the characters of Huila become part of your digital family. A serious game about memory, tradition and regional pride.

products.name: Opita Market
products.tagline_es: El marketplace para comprar y vender en Huila y Colombia
products.tagline_en: The marketplace to buy and sell in Huila and Colombia
products.description_es: Marketplace multi-vertical con verificación de identidad, escrow M2M y logística local. Pagos con Nequi, Daviplata, Bancolombia y tarjetas.
products.description_en: Multi-vertical marketplace with identity verification, M2M escrow and local logistics. Payments with Nequi, Daviplata, Bancolombia and cards.

products.name: Opita Trabajos
products.tagline_es: Conectamos el mejor talento opita con empresas que valoran la tierra
products.tagline_en: We connect the best opita talent with companies that value the land
products.description_es: Plataforma de empleo con enfoque regional. Las empresas contratan, los opitas trabajan, todos ganan.
products.description_en: Employment platform with a regional focus. Companies hire, opitas work, everyone wins.

products.name: Opita Developer
products.tagline_es: Documentación técnica y recursos para construir sobre el ecosistema
products.tagline_en: Technical documentation and resources to build on the ecosystem
products.description_es: El hub de docs, APIs, SDKs y guías para developers. Todo open source, todo en español y en inglés.
products.description_en: The hub of docs, APIs, SDKs and guides for developers. All open source, all in Spanish and English.

products.name: Opita OS
products.tagline_es: El sistema operativo para tu negocio, hecho en Colombia
products.tagline_en: The operating system for your business, made in Colombia
products.description_es: Suite integrada: CRM, facturación electrónica DIAN, nómina, inventario. Para MiPymes colombianas que no quieren 10 softwares distintos.
products.description_en: Integrated suite: CRM, DIAN e-invoicing, payroll, inventory. For Colombian SMBs that don't want 10 different software tools.

products.name: Opita Studio
products.tagline_es: Producción audiovisual y marketing para marcas con identidad
products.tagline_en: Audiovisual production and marketing for brands with identity
products.description_es: Estudio interno de producción de video, motion graphics y campañas digitales. Potenciado por maria-trabajos (AI video pipeline).
products.description_en: In-house video production, motion graphics and digital campaigns studio. Powered by maria-trabajos (AI video pipeline).

products.name: Opita Barber
products.tagline_es: Reservas y gestión para barberías y peluquerías
products.tagline_en: Bookings and management for barbershops and salons
products.description_es: SaaS vertical para barberías: agenda online, recordatorios por WhatsApp, pagos con Nequi, fidelización.
products.description_en: Vertical SaaS for barbershops: online scheduling, WhatsApp reminders, Nequi payments, loyalty program.

products.name: DarkAgents
products.tagline_es: Framework open source de agentes AI para pentesting ético
products.tagline_en: Open source AI agent framework for ethical pentesting
products.description_es: 9 dominios especializados (carder, scrapper, fuzzer, reverser, osint, llm-sec, db2md, pentester, markitdown) para investigación de seguridad con AI.
products.description_en: 9 specialized domains (carder, scrapper, fuzzer, reverser, osint, llm-sec, db2md, pentester, markitdown) for AI-powered security research.
